Fierce Wings Quirk.name: Fierce Wings Quirk
Fierce Wings Quirk.description:
🪶 You have red wings and control each feather even after it detaches.

🌱 At the start you fly twenty meters, hover briefly and guide about six feathers within twenty meters to lift a five-kilogram bag or sense sound without sight.
📈 With training: clothing pins, feather blades, adult rescues, faster flight, many simultaneous feather tasks.
⚠️ You lose lift as feathers leave; intact ones can return, but fire destroys them and regrowth takes days, while deep burns can damage your wings.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Finite Fuel, as lost feathers reduce your flight supply.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Keigo Takami / Hawks's Fierce Wings. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.
🎒 Starts with: Quirk fuel pack x5, Fuel belt

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Red Wing Hop, Quill Clothing Pin
Fierce Wings Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: red wings; feathers move at will, attached or not. Start: 20 m flights, hovers, about six feathers in 20 m, jointly lifting about 5 kg. Feather vibrations sense nearby motion and sound, no images. Carrying adults, many far feathers need training.
Limits: finite feathers: sending them shrinks the wings, cutting speed, lift, then flight; intact ones reattach, lost ones regrow over days. Fire burns them; bad burns go deeper. Pinned feathers can break or be pulled. Senses no silent objects or thoughts.
Quirk Strain: light: short flight, clothing pin; moderate: listen, cut, carry one adult; heavy: rapid interception, multitasking; severe: full deployment, sustained rescue.
Drawback: built in, the canon Finite Fuel.
Canon: Keigo Takami / Hawks's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Mutant.
Law: rescues need safe routes; pursuit, restraint, private listening need lawful authority.
Look: red wings.
